2. The appellant challenging enrolment of the property of Taltali Jame Mosque Waqf Estate and appointment of its Motually unsuccessfully filed Miscellaneous E. C. Case No.9 of 1984 before the Administrator of Waqf Government of Bangladesh whereupon he preferred Title Appeal No. 3 of 1988 before the learned District Judge, Chandpur. The appeal was fixed for hearing on 4.11.1991 on which date the appellant was found absent when the appeal was called on for hearing. The learned District Judge then asked the appellant to show cause as to why the appeal should not be dismissed for default fixing 18.11.1991 as the next date. On 18.11.1991 also the appellant did not appear and as such the appeal was dismissed for default. 

 6. He further submits that the appellant being seriously ill during the period in question was prevented from appearing at the time when the appeal was called upon for hearing and the High Court Division committed error in not considering this aspect of the case. 

 (2) The Court shall then, if it does not dismiss the appeal at once, hear the respondent against the appeal, and in such case the appellant shall be entitled to reply." 

 13. In view of the discussion made above, we are of the opinion that the High Court Division decided the case correctly and no interference is called for.
